Object: van 512 (`unit_number '512'`, MLA-508214). ### 2. Act now / wait / refuse; eligibility
Act now. Visible grounds: refund doc Term 1 "A credit balance standing on a unit … that has been turned in is refunded before the unit closes, at the request of a named authorized signer"; unit `turn_in_date '2026-10-05'`, `closed_date ''`, `charges_due_balance -6514.87`. But the refund result waits on three ledger states (item 6), so the refund is the last write.

### 3. Business object, keys, include/exclude
Unit `6d339cbf-…6770` (only fleet unit). Fleet Select, `closed_end_commercial`, cargo_van, VIN 1KF5W2RB2RD514236, title_state MI. Most recent rental invoice: billing_period 2026-10 (dated 2026-10-01, due 2026-10-21, amount 1365.05: dep 1086.40, lease 161.38, mgmt 40.00, tax 77.27). ### 4. Scored parameters (formula, inputs, tiers, values)
**(a) Early termination charge.** Computation doc: "the termination fee, which is the closed-end early termination fee for the unit's program tier" (Fleet Select 750, schedule Part B); order "schedule first; multiplier; credits never below zero; addition last; round once". Tiers found from records:
- months remaining 2026-10-05→2027-06-30 = 8 whole → "7 to 11 … multiplied by the months remaining and divided by 12" → 500.00;
- upfit 6420/47900 = 13.4% > 10%, cargo van, 27 whole months in service at turn-in (<36) → ×1.10 → 550.00;
- notice 2026-08-20→2026-10-05 = 46 days → $75; active Kestrel Care Platinum on the van's VIN → $60; active retail (5307716482, status active) and active balloon (5419283376, status active) → $200; 550−335 = 215.00;
- usage: miles 64980−37 = 64943 vs 66×826 = 54516 / 82×826 = 67732 (826 days in-service→turn-in) → +$75.
→ **290.00**. Fall-back (computation doc alone): **750.00**.

**(b) Excess mileage charge.** Computation doc: miles driven − (annual allowance × months in service / 12), × class rate 0.25, round. Tiers:
- allowance earned at turn-in: before scheduled end and 27 whole months ≥ 12 → 25000×826/365 = 56575.342;
- miles over 8367.658, less relationship allowance 2000 (retail funding 2022-03-16, 55 whole months ≥ 36) → 6367.658;
- rate 0.25 + unit-age 0.02 (27 whole months: 24–35) − reduction 0.03 (balloon active, 0 dpd; retail active but `days_past_due 35`) = 0.24;
- priced 1528.238 × maintenance multiplier 0.95 (active Kestrel Care Platinum on the VIN) = 1451.826.
→ **1451.83**. Fall-back: 25000×28/12 = 58333.33 allowance (schedule `months_in_service 28`), 6609.67 × 0.25 = **1652.42**.

**(c) Late charge, billing period 2026-10.** Computation doc: (invoice amount − payments applied to that month) × tier % (1.5) / 100, never below tier minimum (25), round. Tiers:
- base from invoice parts: invoice dated 2026-10-01, 4 days before turn-in (1–30) → dep + lease = 1247.78 (no payments applied);
- rate: active balloon with 0 dpd and unit late charge 2026-03-27 within 12 whole months (7) → 1.25% → 15.597;
- minimum: 28 whole months in service (in-service→today) → $15 → 15.597 stands;
- lateness: 2026-10-21→2026-11-09 = 19 days → ×1.10; wind-down: notice 2026-08-20 before invoice date and unit turned in → ×0.75 → 12.868;
- retail delinquency addition: retail late charges 2026-10-15 (0 whole months) and 2026-06-15 (4) within 6; 2026-03-15 (7) outside → two → +$15.
→ **27.87**. Fall-back: max(1365.05×1.5%, 25) = **25.00**.

**(d) Refund.** Computation doc: credit balance = charges due balance taken as positive; "Any holdback is subtracted … never below zero … rounded once". After (a)–(c): 6514.87 − 290.00 − 1451.83 − 27.87 = 4745.17. Holdbacks:
- clearing: returnable remittances within last whole month = business check 1379.92 (2026-11-04; the 6500 ACH credit is not returnable); unit late charges within 12 whole months after (c) is posted = 2026-03-27 + today's = two → whole 1379.92;
- condition reserve: closed-end, turned in 35 days ago (31–60) → $300;
- retail delinquency reserve: two retail late charges in 6 whole months → $1,000;
- toll: turned in 35 days ago (≤60), title state MI not on the list → $100.
→ **1965.25** by ach_credit. Fall-back (computation doc, prerequisites posted, no holdback): **4745.17**.

### 5. Tool sequence, owners, terminal state
find_customers → verify_customer_identity → find_fleet_units / requests / transactions → cross-product finders (retail, balloon, care) → agent: bill_early_termination_18cdd752(unit, 290.00); bill_excess_mileage_e7ed45ad(unit, 1451.83); assess_late_charge_6db1a799(unit, "2026-10", 27.87) (these three in any order among themselves) → unlock and hand over request_credit_refund_a747b6b6 → user submits (unit, 1965.25, ach_credit). Terminal: three new charges on the unit ledger plus one refund; charges due balance −4745.17 + 1965.25 = −2779.92 (the held-back amount).

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root: refund of the credit balance (customer's own write). Blocked-side sentences (turned_in_unit_credit_refund Terms 2–4): "The refund is not made until the unit's ledger carries the early termination charge owed for a closed-end unit turned in before its scheduled end date." / "Nor is the refund made until the unit's ledger carries the excess mileage charge owed…" / "The refund is figured only after the unit's ledger carries the late charge owed on the unit's most recent rental invoice month once that month's grace period has fully run out."
- Hop 1 (ET) — **state-derived**: records show closed-end, turn-in 2026-10-05 < scheduled end 2027-06-30, no `early_termination_fee` posting. Searching "early termination charge" finds closed_end_early_termination_charge: "once it is billed, the unit's ledger carries that early termination charge" → the write is that policy's billing.
- Hop 2 (EM) — **state-derived**: miles 64943 exceed any allowance reading; no `excess_mileage_charge` posting; closed_end_excess_mileage_charge: "once billed, the unit's ledger carries that excess mileage charge".
- Hop 3 (LC) — **state-derived**: 2026-10 invoice due 10-21; Fleet Select grace 5 days (quick reference) → first permissible 10-27 < today; nothing recorded against 2026-10; no late charge for 2026-10; rental_invoice_late_charge: "A late charge falls due on an invoice month that went unpaid past its grace period … once assessed, the unit's ledger carries a late charge for that billing period".
- Order: the three hops are independent of each other (no visible sentence links them; none of their computations reads another's posting); all precede the refund. Hop 3 additionally changes the refund's clearing-holdback tier (late-charge count 1 → 2), which the "figured only after" wording fixes.
- No hop is pre-solved: the refund doc names only its own tool; no route, chain or other problem's tool appears on the blocked side.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Refund only what was asked (6514.87 or the two overpayments 7879.92)": excluded by Terms 2–4 (state-form waits) and the computation doc's "Any holdback is subtracted".
- "No late charge because the account is in credit": excluded by late_charge_figure_most_recent_month (b) "payments the unit's ledger records against that month… a payment recorded against no invoice month is not counted" and the arrangement doc's current basis "applied to the oldest unpaid invoice month first unless the remittance names the months it pays" (both remittances named months).
- Platinum Elite on the sedan: excluded by "A contract covers the unit when its VIN is the VIN on the unit's schedule".
- Cancelled June notice: unit records 2026-08-20; factor docs read "the termination notice date recorded on the unit".
- Clearing holdback half vs whole: decided by Term 4 "figured only after the unit's ledger carries the late charge" → count includes today's charge → whole.
- Excess mileage baseline months (28 vs 27 whole) is moot under the allowance factor (days-based branch).
